record.body:
## Basis

needs-you-close established that human gates clear through the CLI. dashboard-approvals requires detail + confirm, displayed-revision guards, and recorded notes. Phase Non-goals keep existing backlog promote/dismiss. A blanket read-only constraint is stale; this constraint names the full allowed write set (Needs-you gates + backlog promote/dismiss).

payload.applies_to: dashboard/dismiss.py, dashboard Needs-you confirm UX, and dashboard/backlog.py promote/dismiss
payload.statement: The dashboard may write to the artifact store only for: (1) human Needs-you gates (continuity-question answer/reject-routing, unsigned manual check sign, finding accept-risk) via the adaptive-artifacts CLI using the displayed record revision and a recorded decision or note as designed; and (2) backlog promote/dismiss of project:backlog-item via the adaptive-artifacts CLI (existing backlog path). No other dashboard store writes.

record.subject: dashboard-human-gate-writes
